title: 5-a-day daily-drill builder
summary: Self-contained tool page like CreateExamPaper.tsx. Teacher picks subject + year-group + skills (multi-select specRefs) + weeks; the builder emits 5 questions × 5 weekdays × N weeks worksheets, mark-tariff-balanced (1+2+3+3+5=14 marks/day default), seeded by inputs so identical params produce identical packs (CI-stable). Pure deterministic — pulls from the existing past-paper question bank + curriculum bank exemplars. Multi-page PDF export.
motivation: Corbettmaths 5-a-day workbooks are the canonical UK 'daily drill' format — praised by every Year 11 maths teacher in the review corpus. The send-assistant Unit Pack handles multi-lesson sequences but not the daily-drill habit-building format. Builds directly on top of unitPack.ts.

in: client/src/lib/fiveADayBuilder.ts (new, ~180 LoC) — pure builder buildFiveADay({ subject, yearGroup, weeks, skills, weekdays, calculator, seed }) -> { worksheets: ExamPaperWorksheet[] }
client/src/lib/tool-registry.ts — append ToolEntry { id: 'five-a-day', hub: 'revision', icon: CalendarDays, sendTo: ['differentiate', 'flash-cards', 'audio-revision-hub'] }
client/src/pages/hubs/RevisionHubSection.tsx — append a 6th storyboard step 'Build a 5-a-day pack'
Targeted vitest in client/src/lib/__tests__/fiveADayBuilder.test.ts (~12 cases): mark balance, weekday on/off, seed determinism, calc filtering, empty-skill warning
out: Spaced-repetition scheduler over the skill list (deferred to H12 — Leitner / SM-2)
Pupil-facing daily streak (deferred to H4 — gamification)
Auto-email-the-day's-pack (deferred to PR-28 — needs transactional email)

acceptance_criteria: buildFiveADay called twice with identical inputs returns deep-equal output (seed determinism).
Each day's mark total is within ±2 marks of the requested daily budget.
Skills rotate fairly: over 5 weeks × 5 days = 25 questions, each requested skill appears at least floor(25 / numSkills) times.
Calculator policy filters questions correctly (no calc-required questions in non-calc days).
Multi-page PDF export honours the existing print-preset bleed + stapling-edge rules.
Empty-skill list returns empty result + a warning (does NOT throw).

risk_register.risk: Skill bank is too thin for some specRefs and the builder repeats
risk_register.mitigation: Builder tracks `usedQuestionIds` and warns when ≥30% of a day's questions are repeats from earlier days. Falls back to anotherOneLikeThis (G2) when bank is exhausted.

risk_register.risk: Mark balance drifts when the bank doesn't have a 5-mark question for a specRef
risk_register.mitigation: Builder uses a relaxed budget — first-fit knapsack with ±2 mark tolerance, documented in the test fixtures.

related: G6 — predicted-paper builder (similar bank-driven assembly pattern)
H12 — spaced-repetition (Phase H builds on G5 with a Leitner / SM-2 scheduler)
